updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: OCR Support for Endpoint Devices
updates.summary: Purview Data Loss Prevention is gaining optical character recognition (OCR) capabilities to detect sensitive content embedded in images (JPG, PNG, TIFF, BMP, PDF) on Windows endpoints and automatically apply DLP policies to prevent exfiltration. This extends data protection beyond text-based documents to visual media, closing a significant gap in endpoint data loss prevention.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Posture Management Redesign
updates.summary: Microsoft is launching a major evolution of Purview DSPM with AI-driven capabilities, including unified visibility across traditional and AI environments, Security Copilot integration for automated triage and policy management, and enhanced posture reporting. This redesign helps security teams prioritize and remediate data risks faster in AI-forward organizations.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Labels for Entra Security Groups
updates.summary: Administrators can now apply sensitivity labels directly to Microsoft Entra cloud security groups, leveraging the same label configurations already in use for Microsoft 365 groups and sites with no additional setup required. This extends Purview's governance and classification capabilities to identity-based security groups, improving data governance consistency across the identity and collaboration surfaces.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Export DLP and Label Policy Configurations
updates.summary: Purview now allows administrators to export their DLP policies and label publishing configurations as a downloadable ZIP file directly from the portal, streamlining troubleshooting by enabling quick attachment of complete policy schemas to support tickets. This operational improvement reduces the friction in diagnosing policy configuration issues.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Expanding Archive Mailboxes Beyond 1.5 TB
updates.summary: Archive mailboxes can now automatically expand beyond the previous 1.5 TB limit for eligible E5 licensees, ensuring uninterrupted retention and data availability without mailbox lockout. This capability addresses scalability concerns for organizations with large compliance retention requirements.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Graph API Support for Archive Mailboxes
updates.summary: Microsoft Graph API now provides unified access to archive mailboxes (main and auxiliary), offering administrators a seamless, consolidated archive view and enabling modern API-driven management as EWS Graph APIs are deprecated. This API enhancement improves integration options for compliance and retention workflows.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Permissions Audit Log Improvements
updates.summary: Enhanced audit logging in the Purview portal now provides clearer visibility into role and scoped-role access decisions, helping administrators troubleshoot access denial issues and monitor authorization outcomes. Better audit trails improve security operations and access governance visibility.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Inline Protection for Entra-Managed Apps in Edge for Business
updates.summary: Purview DLP inline protection for Microsoft Entra-managed apps in Edge for Business now integrates with Conditional Access controls, supporting expanded conditions, multiple activities per rule, simulation mode, and enhanced alerting. This integration simplifies configuration and extends DLP enforcement across browser-based productivity scenarios.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Scale Increase to 500K Files Daily
updates.summary: The maximum auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive has increased from 100,000 to 500,000 files per tenant per day, allowing organizations to label and protect more data at rest faster. This capacity improvement helps close data classification gaps and prepares data estates more quickly for Microsoft 365 Copilot adoption.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP and Collections for Intune-Managed Mobile Apps
updates.summary: Purview DLP now extends to Intune Mobile Application Management (MAM)-protected mobile apps, enabling content-aware protection policies that evaluate clipboard actions and data sharing against DLP rules on mobile devices. This integration addresses mobile data exfiltration risks and insider threats across Intune-managed workflows.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management Alert Notes and Collaboration
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management now supports direct note-taking within alerts for analysts to document investigation progress and share findings, plus automatic system-generated notes for status changes and assignments. This centralized investigation history improves collaboration and creates an auditable timeline for triage and case work.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management Enhanced User Profile Context
updates.summary: IRM alerts now display enriched user profile data (employee type, office location, start date, policy inclusion, priority user status, last working day) directly in the alert workflow, reducing the need for analysts to context-switch. Enhanced user context helps investigators make faster, more informed risk assessments during triage.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Integration with Entra Global Secure Access
updates.summary: Purview DLP now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to protect sensitive data at the network layer, including text, files, and AI interactions across browsers, apps, APIs, and generative AI platforms, with detection of risky activity through Insider Risk Management. This network-level enforcement prevents data exfiltration to untrusted cloud applications and collaborative platforms.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Barriers Compliance Report
updates.summary: A new Information Barriers compliance report capability helps administrators identify SharePoint sites, OneDrive accounts, and SharePoint Embedded containers that no longer comply after policy changes. This reporting feature simplifies governance tracking and remediation of policy drift.

updates.title: CVE-2026-96940: Microsoft Exchange Server Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: A weak authorization vulnerability in Microsoft Exchange Server allows authenticated attackers to elevate privileges over the network. Organizations should apply patches immediately to close this authenticated escalation path.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69435: Azure SRE Agent Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: Missing authorization checks in Azure SRE Agent allow authorized attackers to elevate privileges over the network. This vulnerability affects Azure control-plane operations and should be patched to prevent privilege escalation by authenticated actors.

updates.title: CVE-2026-94510: Microsoft Bookings Authorization Bypass and Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: An authorization bypass vulnerability in Microsoft Bookings allows unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over the network through user-controlled key manipulation. Organizations using Bookings should apply available patches.
